items.difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that a category cofibred in groupoids satisfying (S2) satisfies the same condition with the algebra of dual numbers replaced by the algebra of a finite dimensional vector space (statement lines 2871-2877). The proof (proof lines 2879-3092) handles the case of sets through the Schlessinger description and then runs an induction on the dimension splitting off one coordinate, proving the existence and the injectivity halves of the condition by comparing objects through the two halves of (S2). H3: a full induction with a genuine splitting argument on both halves of the condition, written out in full.
